Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, that you may win.
Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.

translations.web: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.
translations.bsb: Likewise, a competitor does not receive the crown unless he competes according to the rules.
translations.kjv: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he ➔ not crowned, except he strive lawfully.
translations.asv: And if also a man contend in the games, he is not crowded, except he have contended lawfully.
